title: Medusa issue-to-merge completion
objective: Select one open Medusa issue without an implementation PR, implement the bounded change, validate the complete relevant repository surface, merge it into main, and close the linked issue only when its acceptance criteria are evidenced.
criteria: The chosen issue is open, has no active implementation PR, and has a bounded definition of done
The implementation covers the accepted scope without unrelated changes
Targeted tests and the relevant full-workspace qualification pass or any resource failure is explicitly documented
All required GitHub checks pass and no actionable review thread remains
The PR is merged into main
The linked issue is closed with exact implementation and validation evidence
operating_rules: Work one issue at a time
Inspect all failures from a validation run before changing code
Do not silently retry linker or resource failures
Do not claim completion while a required workflow is pending
Treat live external evidence slices as separate acceptance criteria when an issue requires them
